summary: PepsiCo filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its existing $5 billion 364-day unsecured revolving credit facility dated May 23, 2025, and the entry into a new $5 billion 364-day unsecured revolving credit facility on May 22, 2026. No borrowings were outstanding at termination. The new facility serves as a liquidity backstop for commercial paper programs. This is a routine refinancing of a credit line, not a special situation event. There is no transaction price, premium, or activist involvement. The filing is a standard current report on other events; no risk-arb angle or advisory roles apply.
